repos_data.description: Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.
Latitude is the open-source AI monitoring platform.
🪢 Open source AI engineering platform: LLM evals, observability, metrics, prompt management, playground, datasets. Integrates with OpenTelemetry, LangChain, OpenAI SDK, LiteLLM, and more. 🍊YC W23
Open-source, end-to-end platform for evaluating, observing, and improving LLM and AI agent applications. Tracing · Evals · Simulations · Datasets · Gateway · Guardrails. Self-hostable. Apache 2.0.

The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]

localaik is a local compatibility server for a subset of the Gemini and OpenAI APIs. Run one container locally, point your SDK to it, and the proxy serves both protocol shapes on the same port for tests and development.
The platform for LLM evaluations and AI agent testing
Know what your AI agents cost. API gateway with budget enforcement, session tracking, and MCP tools.

A Go toolkit for building AI agents and applications across multiple providers. Unified LLM client, agent framework with handoffs, tool calling, streaming, structured output, MCP integration, and cost tracking.

AI gateway / AI control plane / AI proxy written in Go. Unified OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, xAI, Ollama, vLLM and more. A LiteLLM alternative with observability, guardrails, streaming, cost tracking, intelligent routing, sticky sessions, failover, real-time logs and usage tracking. Prod ready.
Local-first flight recorder for AI agents: every LLM call, tool call, cost, and loop captured by a transparent proxy. Zero code changes.
Universal LLM API client — 163 providers, 14 native language bindings, powered by a Rust core

repo_meta_data.description: Open source LLM observability and monitoring. Drop-in proxy for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini with request logging, cost tracking, and agent tracing. Self-host with one Docker command. MIT.
